messages:
alice: Heads up — canary for svc-search failed on us-west-2 after today's push. Pod crashloop with image pull error.
bob: saw that, looking at deploybot logs. deploybot: `deploy attempt for svc-search:release-2026-03-15 failed: image pull error: manifest for digest not found for platform arm64`
carol: interesting — the build published a multi-arch manifest to gcr, then mirror job s3-mirror pushed to ECR. Could be manifest list got flattened.
dave: logs from mirror job (skopeo):
```
INFO: copying manifest list
WARN: skipping non-matching manifest for platform arm64
```
That WARN looks bad.
alice: can we confirm whether GCR has arm64 entry in manifest list?
bob: `gcr.io/project/svc-search:release-2026-03-15` manifest inspect shows amd64 + arm64, sha256:aaa.. and sha256:bbb..
registry-bot: `us-east-1.ecr.aws/ourorg/svc-search:release-2026-03-15` manifest inspect shows only amd64 -> sha256:aaa..
carol: so mirror dropped arm64 entry. Deploybot in us-west picks ECR mirror and tries to pull arm64 digest which is missing -> crash.
dave: root cause likely `skopeo copy` defaulted to single-arch copy because mirror job omitted `--all` or platform filter. Buildkite pipeline changed recently (bb/ci#452) to speed up pushes and removed `--all` inadvertently.
alice: ugh. That explains why only canary (which runs arm64) fails. Stables on amd64 in prod were fine.
bob: mitigation plan: 1) pin canary to the amd64 digest for immediate recovery OR 2) re-run mirror with `skopeo copy --all` to include arm64 and retag, then redeploy canary. Which do we want?
carol: prefer re-mirror so artifact is correct in registry. But that takes ~10-15m and a redeploy. Pinning to amd64 is risky for arm nodes.
dave: suggestion: temporarily route canary traffic to a small amd64 pool and mark arm64 canary instances unschedulable. That keeps canary up while we fix mirror.
alice: short-term: retag fallback — bob, can you trigger mirror with `--all` and verify manifest list on ECR, then redeploy? If mirror step fails, fallback to pin amd64 digest and abort arm64 rollouts.
bob: triggering manual mirror now: `skopeo copy --all docker://gcr.io/project/svc-search:release-2026-03-15 docker://public.ecr.aws/ourorg/svc-search:release-2026-03-15`
bob: mirror completed. verify: `skopeo inspect --raw docker://public.ecr.aws/ourorg/svc-search:release-2026-03-15 | jq '.manifests | length'` -> 2
registry-bot: ECR manifest list now contains amd64 and arm64 digests.
deploybot: retriggering canary deploy for svc-search -> starting rollout.
alice: monitoring pods — looks like arm64 pods are pulling and coming up. :tada:
carol: root cause action item: update publish mirror job in bb/ci to always use `--all` and add an integrity check that manifest list length matches origin (gcr) before marking publish success.
dave: also add a quick smoke in deploybot for mixed-arch services to validate all platforms post-publish (10m window). I can draft a PR for that.
alice: approved. bob mark that as postmortem follow-up and add to release notes:
```
- svc-search: fixed multi-arch mirror to ECR; canary briefly failed due to missing arm64 in ECR manifest list (mirror omitted --all). Rollout recovered after re-mirroring.
```
bob: added to release notes and created ticket INFRA-2241 for the pipeline fix.
carol: thanks everyone, closing thread once deploybot confirms stable.
deploybot: canary -> stable promotion completed at 1765555299.
